result:
There is now one New session button, and every mic surface shows the same indicator. It's merged into `michael/dev`, and the landing line is checked with `tail` on `task.jsonl`.

- **New session:** the sheet, the AI tab and the Dictate page all call the button in `chat.js`; the two duplicate copies are gone. Pressing it cleared the session and the thread on the 400 px sheet and the 1200 px drawer.
- **Mic indicator:** a new `MicIndicator` class in `ux/Dictate` shows a red dot, "listening" and a level bar under the chat composer. A dot-only version sits on the floating mic, the ✦ button and the ☰, so a collapsed surface still shows the mic is open. Shots are at 400 and 1200. Only the 400 px sheet shot has a real open mic; the drawer, collapsed and menu shots set the open state by hand, and the floating-mic shots also force the floating mic visible.
- **Your call:** a press clears the session and the next sentence starts the new one, so the URL doesn't change. Routing to a new session page on every press would pull you off the page you're on. This is written in `doc/chat.md`; I did not put a `Note:` card on the board for it.
- **Docs:** `doc/chat.md` and `doc/surfaces.md` are updated. I added a small `doc/file/Dictate.js.md` because the Files tab was 404ing on it and that blocked the merge.
- **Fence:** I touched a few files outside the brief's fence (`menu.js`, `push-to-talk.js`, `Widget.js`, `rail.css`), each a one- or two-line change for the indicator.
